text:
Huh? [VAR 1003][VAR 0100(0000)] and Hop?\c
Ah! I completely forgot about the
Championship Match!
What’re you two doing here?[VAR 0114(000B)]

Haven’t you been watching the news at all?
The tournament is off, Sonia!\c
The chairman saw to that—and to sending the
entire region into a state of havoc![VAR 0114(0008)]

Huh?\c
What?!\c
What happened while I was researching things in
the Slumbering Weald?[VAR 0114(000B)]

Well, for starters, there’s a great black storm or
something raging over Hammerlocke Stadium.\c
What’re they calling it? “The Darkest Day”?
It’s thrown everything into disarray![VAR 0114(0008)]
Still, I’m sure we don’t need to worry too much...\c\nThe unbeatable Champion will be able to take\ncare of everything, won’t he?[VAR 0114(0008)]
Hold on a tick, ma’am. Did you say “the\nDarkest Day”?[VAR 0114(000B)]
“The Darkest Day” is the name for the\nblack storm that nearly brought the\r\nGalar region to ruin in ancient times...[VAR 0114(000B)]
I’m here to stop the Darkest Day!
To search for the sword Pokémon
To search for the shield Pokémon
To stop the Darkest Day...\c\nYou mean you’re going to search for the sword\nand shield Pokémon?[VAR 0114(000B)]

I suppose if the legends are true, then the sword
and shield Pokémon should be able to prevent
the Darkest Day from coming to pass...\c
They may be just what we need to beat back
the black storm![VAR 0114(000B)]

OK! Here, take this.
You should head to the Slumbering Weald.\c
I’ll catch up with you once I’m done looking
into something that’s been bothering me.[VAR 0114(000B)]
I’ve got to keep looking into the origin of the\nsword and shield Pokémon![VAR 0114(000B)]
All that matters is that you do what you can.\nYou’ve become a fine Pokémon Trainer,\r\nafter all![VAR 0114(0008)]
